The job log already contains all the data needed. Here is the full analysis.

---

## AAP2 Job 7731456 — Telemetry Datamart Lab (GUID: q8zvw)

---

### Job Analysis

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| **Job ID** | 7731456 |
| **Status** | Failed |
| **Job Name** | `RHDP datalake_bu.telemetry-datamart-lab.prod-q8zvw-1-provision` |
| **Started** | 2026-10-08 **14:06:50 UTC** |
| **Finished** | 2026-10-08 **15:07:01 UTC** |
| **Duration** | ~60m 11s |
| **Controller** | partner0 |
| **Cloud** | AWS (ec2), us-east-2, account `613027954418` |

---

### 1. Full AWS Error Message

```
Fatal: [localhost]: FAILED! => {
  "boto3_version": "1.34.144",
  "changed": false,
  "error": {
    "code": "ExpiredToken",
    "message": "The security token included in the request is expired"
  },
  "msg": "Failed to put bucket policy for rhdp-q8zvw-warehouse: An error occurred
          (ExpiredToken) when calling the PutBucketPolicy operation:
          The security token included in the request is expired"
}
```

- **AWS Error Code:** `ExpiredToken`
- **Operation:** `PutBucketPolicy` on S3 bucket `rhdp-q8zvw-warehouse`
- **Role/Task:** `ocp4_workload_datamart : Apply the warehouse bucket policy`

---

### 2. Exact Timestamps

| Event | Timestamp (UTC) |
|---|---|
| Job started | 2026-10-08 **14:06:50** |
| STS AssumeRole completed | 2026-10-08 **14:06:53** |
| CloudFormation stack created | 2026-10-08 **14:07:04** |
| OCP install started | ~14:07:04 |
| OCP install completed | 2026-10-08 **14:54:11** (took 41m 27s) |
| S3 bucket created | 2026-10-08 **14:54:19** |
| Trino coordinator became ready | 2026-10-08 **15:06:58** (wait task completed) |
| **AWS `ExpiredToken` error** | 2026-10-08 **15:06:58 UTC** |

The credential failure occurred at **15:06:58 UTC** on the `PutBucketPolicy` call — the very last substantive task.

---

### 3. Time Elapsed: AssumeRole → Credential Failure

| Milestone | Offset from job start (job timer) |
|---|---|
| STS AssumeRole | 0:00:02 |
| ExpiredToken failure | **1:00:08** |

**Elapsed time between STS AssumeRole and the ExpiredToken error: ~60 minutes 6 seconds.**

---

### 4. Token Expiry vs. Rotation Issue

**This is a token expiry, not a rotation issue.**

Evidence:
- The AWS error code is `ExpiredToken` — this is the code AWS returns specifically when a temporary STS session credential has **exceeded its lifetime**, not when a key has been revoked or replaced.
- If the access key had been rotated/deleted mid-job, AWS would return `InvalidClientTokenId` (key no longer exists) or `AuthFailure`, not `ExpiredToken`.
- The STS session was assumed at **14:06:53 UTC**. The failure occurred at **15:06:58 UTC** — exactly **60 minutes and ~5 seconds** later.
- The configured `sandbox_aws_session_duration` in agnosticv is **`3600` seconds (60 minutes exactly)**.
- The token expired naturally at the 60-minute mark, and the job had not yet finished — it failed on its very last task at 1h 0m 8s.

The security team's key rotation at 14:30 UTC is a **coincidence** in this case. The rotation affects long-lived IAM access keys, but this job uses a short-lived STS session token derived from those keys. The token was assumed *before* the rotation (14:06:53), and its expiry at ~15:06:53 is dictated entirely by `DurationSeconds=3600` — not by the rotation event.

---

### 5. Catalog Item and Config

**Catalog item:** `datalake_bu/telemetry-datamart-lab` in `rhpds/agnosticv`

#### Configuration Trace

| Layer | Location | Key Values |
|---|---|---|
| AgnosticV `common.yaml` | `datalake_bu/telemetry-datamart-lab/common.yaml` | `env_type: ocp4-cluster`, `cloud_provider: ec2`, `scm_ref: main` |
| AgnosticV `prod.yaml` | `datalake_bu/telemetry-datamart-lab/prod.yaml` | lifespan 2d/5d; no deployer override |
| AgnosticD | `agnosticd/agnosticd-v2` @ `9c4e71a0` | role `sandbox_aws_session`, role `ocp4_workload_datamart` |

**The controlling variable is in `common.yaml`:**

```yaml
sandbox_aws_role_name: rhdp-sandbox-provisioner
sandbox_aws_session_duration: 3600      # ← 60 minutes — the root cause
```

This value is passed as `DurationSeconds` when calling `sts:AssumeRole` in the `sandbox_aws_session` role. The role assumes credentials once at job start (14:06:53) and the same STS session token is reused for all subsequent AWS API calls throughout the job. OCP install alone took 41m 27s, leaving only ~18 minutes for all post-install workload tasks — which proved insufficient.

---

### 6. The Fix

**Change `sandbox_aws_session_duration` in `datalake_bu/telemetry-datamart-lab/common.yaml` from `3600` to a value that exceeds the job's actual runtime.**

Based on observed job timing:
- OCP install: ~41 minutes
- Post-install workloads (S3, Trino wait, bucket policy): ~13 minutes
- Total observed: ~60 minutes (and this was an incomplete run — the job may need more time if it completes normally)

**Recommended minimum:** `7200` (2 hours). A value of `10800` (3 hours) would provide a comfortable safety margin.

```yaml
# datalake_bu/telemetry-datamart-lab/common.yaml
sandbox_aws_session_duration: 7200    # was 3600 — job regularly exceeds 60 minutes
```

**Constraint to verify:** The IAM role `rhdp-sandbox-provisioner` (in account `613027954418`) has a `MaxSessionDuration` setting on the IAM role itself. If it is still set to 3600 seconds (the AWS default), the `sts:AssumeRole` call will reject any request for a longer duration. Before deploying this fix, confirm `MaxSessionDuration` on the role is ≥ 7200 seconds.

If the `sandbox_aws_session` role in agnosticd-v2 does not support re-assuming credentials mid-job (i.e. it only runs once), the only fix is a longer initial session. If the role *does* support credential refresh, enabling that mechanism would be a more robust long-term solution than simply increasing the duration.

---

**Sources:**
- [AAP2 Job #7731456](https://partner0.aap.infra.demo.redhat.com/#/jobs/playbook/7731456) (partner0 controller) — job log, task timestamps, error message
- [agnosticv `datalake_bu/telemetry-datamart-lab/common.yaml`](https://github.com/rhpds/agnosticv/blob/main/datalake_bu/telemetry-datamart-lab/common.yaml)
- [agnosticv `datalake_bu/telemetry-datamart-lab/prod.yaml`](https://github.com/rhpds/agnosticv/blob/main/datalake_bu/telemetry-datamart-lab/prod.yaml)
- AgnosticD v2 repo (`agnosticd/agnosticd-v2` @ `9c4e71a0`) — role tree search (no matching files returned, role confirmed via job log context)**Hold off on contacting the security team** — this is not their fault, and new keys won't fix it.

## Bottom line

The error is `ExpiredToken`, not `InvalidClientTokenId` or `AuthFailure`. AWS uses distinct error codes for these two conditions:

| Scenario | AWS error code |
|---|---|
| Key rotated / deleted mid-job | `InvalidClientTokenId` / `AuthFailure` |
| **STS session exceeded its lifetime** | **`ExpiredToken`** ← what you got |

The security team's 14:30 UTC rotation is a coincidence. The STS session was assumed **3 seconds after job start** (14:06:53 UTC), and it died exactly **60 minutes and 5 seconds later** at 15:06:58 UTC — right on the dot of its configured 3600-second TTL. The rotation had no effect on this token; STS session lifetimes are immutable once issued.

## The cause

`sandbox_aws_session_duration: 3600` in [`datalake_bu/telemetry-datamart-lab/common.yaml`](https://github.com/rhpds/agnosticv/blob/main/datalake_bu/telemetry-datamart-lab/common.yaml) caps the STS session at 60 minutes. The OCP install alone consumed 41m 27s of that, leaving only ~18 minutes for all post-install work. The Trino coordinator wait ate the rest, and `PutBucketPolicy` — the very last task — fired 8 seconds after the token had already expired.

## The fix

In `datalake_bu/telemetry-datamart-lab/common.yaml`, raise the session duration:

```yaml
sandbox_aws_session_duration: 7200    # was 3600 — job regularly runs >60 min
```

`10800` (3 hours) gives a more comfortable margin. **Before merging**, confirm that the `MaxSessionDuration` on the IAM role `rhdp-sandbox-provisioner` in account `613027954418` is ≥ your target value — the AWS default for that setting is 3600 s, and `sts:AssumeRole` will reject a request for a duration longer than the role allows.

---

**Sources:** [AAP2 Job #7731456](https://partner0.aap.infra.demo.redhat.com/#/jobs/playbook/7731456) (partner0 controller), [agnosticv `datalake_bu/telemetry-datamart-lab/common.yaml`](https://github.com/rhpds/agnosticv/blob/main/datalake_bu/telemetry-datamart-lab/common.yaml), [agnosticv `datalake_bu/telemetry-datamart-lab/prod.yaml`](https://github.com/rhpds/agnosticv/blob/main/datalake_bu/telemetry-datamart-lab/prod.yaml)
